step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows a multi-tenant application on Amazon EKS writing to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. AWS Control Tower provisions single-tenant customer accounts containing Amazon QuickSight and AWS VPN. QuickSight queries data from Aurora via AWS Transit Gateway and ingests on-premises customer data via AWS VPN.
